$comment: The defect this gate exists for, as a fixture: a curriculum contract that declares the two definitions and constrains neither. `config` is any object at all, `mode` and `domain_state` are any string. This is exactly what `curriculum.schema.v5.json` did to `kit_power_profile`, `visual_system`, `mode` and `circuit_status` when `G5` was closed by deleting them — a constraint removed from the engine and never landed anywhere. It must be refused as `domain-unconstrained`. Never an input to a run.
